title: Xdrip reporting sensor start hour wrongly
body: This is pervasive in all the version of Xdrip and I don't know whether it could be a question of any setting. The case is that in "state", Xdrip reports one hour earlier the time of sensor start (a Libre), although it's right in the graph. It seems like if it doesn't transform the timestamp to the phone's region. If I start the sensor at 18:00, it reports it was at 17:00. This is a minor issue, but some people should know this when planning when to change the sensor
